name: agent-loop
description: Draw your Claude Code sessions as planetary systems: each step, what it touched, how long it took. Runs locally by default; share with friends through an end-to-end encrypted galaxy group.

server_url.title: Server URL or invite link
server_url.description: Where to report. The default is a server on this computer (npx agent-loop-viz). Paste an invite link (https://…/#k=…) to join a galaxy group: everything except anonymous categories and timings is encrypted with the key in the link.

share.title: How much to share
share.description: auto: full on this computer, summary elsewhere. anonymous: categories and timings only. summary: plus project, session title, each step's tool and target, first line of errors. full: plus complete prompts, tool input/output and answers.

name.title: Galaxy name
name.description: The name others in your galaxy group see for you. Leave empty for an auto-generated catalog number.
